description.value: Big White is a major four-season mountain resort in the Okanagan Highlands east of Kelowna, primarily known as a ski destination but operating a summer bike park and guided eBike tours through alpine terrain. The resort village is largely self-contained, with restaurants, food trucks, a market, medical services, shopping, and a range of accommodation. For cycling tourists, it functions as a destination attraction with lift-accessed mountain biking and organized eBike experiences.
